`Store.GetUser` and `Store.ListUsers` in `store/user.go` call `(*DB).ListUsers` in `store/db/sqlite/user.go`. That triggers: RegisterRoutes — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go` serveUserAvatar — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go` getUserByUsername — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go` Store.GetUser — `store/user.go` Store.ListUsers — `store/user.go` (*DB).ListUsers — `store/db/sqlite/user.go` QueryContext (SELECT … avatar_url … FROM user) — `store/db/sqlite/user.go` user.avatar_url — `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql` Route registration and handler: ```120:125:server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go func (s *FileServerService) RegisterRoutes(echoServer *echo.Echo) { fileGroup := echoServer.Group("/file") fileGroup.GET("/attachments/:uid/:filename", s.serveAttachmentFile) fileGroup.GET("/users/:identifier/avatar", s.serveUserAvatar) } ``` Wired at server startup in `server/server.go:81-82` via `fileServerService.RegisterRoutes(echoServer)`.
